_about: Every rule and tolerance the record checks use. Change behavior here, not in code.

matching._about: Confidence given to each way a listing can be tied to a tax-roll parcel. Checks run only at or above minConfidence; anything lower is listed as unmatched.

livingArea._about: DOR TOT_LVG_AREA is the total *effective* area: the base area plus factored garages, porches and similar (2026 Users Guide, field 50). It is normally larger than MLS heated living area for houses, so for houses only a listing that claims MORE than the effective area by over tolerancePct is flagged. Condos and co-ops have no garages or porches on the unit, so both directions are checked there.

lotSize._about: MLS lot sizes are often converted from rounded acres, so small differences are expected. Skipped for condos and co-ops (DOR leaves LND_SQFOOT blank for them).

useCode._about: DOR use codes (2026 Users Guide, field 8) each listing type may have. Anything else is flagged. Detached condos/villas (004), co-op homes (005), condo-hotel units (039) and homes on agricultural-classified land (050-069) are normal in South Florida.
useCode._newConstruction: A vacant use code is expected when the listing's year built is within newConstructionYears of the roll year (built after the January 1 roll date). Reported as info, not a flag.
useCode._land: A Land listing on a parcel with a building is reported as info (usually a teardown or a lot sold for its land value), not a flag.

lastSale._about: Sale dates come from the DOR Sales Data File (SDF) and the NAL SALE_* fields; both give year and month only.

beds.reason: No allowed public source: the DOR files have no bedroom count, and county appraiser bulk files are not loaded.

baths.reason: No allowed public source: the DOR files have no bathroom count, and county appraiser bulk files are not loaded.

pool.reason: No allowed public source: the DOR files have no pool field, and county appraiser bulk files are not loaded.

taxEstimate._about: Buyer's first full-year bill after the post-sale reset. Uses config/cost-of-sale, config/exemptions and config/millage for the listing's county and taxing district.

fraud._about: Private review signals only. Never shown publicly, never written with owner names. A listing is marked 'closer look' when its points reach closerLookScore.

recentOwnerChange._about: Arm's-length sales (DOR qualification codes 01-06) are ordinary purchases, e.g. flips, which the Last sale check already shows: pointsIfArmsLength. Other transfers just before listing use pointsByQualCode (11 quitclaim/corrective/minimum-stamp deed; 12 financial institution; 18 government; 19 fiduciary; 98/99 pending), else points.
